subject: design/fleet-bridge-v1
statement: After the trigger, the drive verifies **each created item at the goal object** — it exists on the tracker and carries the repo-configured automated-implementation tag — and journals the confirmation (the basis's EVT-4 row, carried per §3.6's entry-type and gist-grammar home — `trigger: wake` for unattended runs, `prompt` preserved for directed ones); a discrepancy routes back through the planning stage's own contract as a reconciliation, never by the drive editing items. While materialized items are in flight, each resulting proposal lands through the lane's routing (AUTO where floor-clearing and activated; HUMAN otherwise), and the drive accepts each landing only at the goal object — commit an ancestor of the mainline (FR-6). **Closure blocks on the full set**: any stranded proposal — merged badge, absent content — blocks the feature's close and alarms on the delivery ledger. Unclaimed items age under the existing aging/bump arm; nothing new watches them.
